Container.Name: budget
Container.Overview: Self-hosted budgeting. Plans recurring bills and income by month, tracks what has actually been paid, and projects the bills account forward to show how much can safely leave it today. Requires a PostgreSQL database.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Host port for the web interface.

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Local timezone. Governs what today means for due dates and projections.

Config.Name: AUTH_MODE
Config.Description: proxy to trust an authenticating reverse proxy, or none for an unprotected LAN-only instance.

Config.Name: AUTH_HEADER
Config.Description: Header carrying the authenticated username when AUTH_MODE is proxy.

Config.Name: AUTO_RECONCILE_SCHEMA
Config.Description: Reconcile the database against the application schema on start.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID owning files in the data volume.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID owning files in the data volume.
